title: Unify swatch scaling and radius progression for action rows
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Multiple component families (action rows, dense tables, and compact button groups) are using inconsistent color swatch scales and radius steps. This causes visual vibration when cards and rows are juxtaposed across analytics pages and leads to duplicated override tokens across components. Objective: Create a single, composable swatch scale and a predictable radius progression that can be consumed by Action Row, Button, TableRow and Chart-legend components. Deliver a migration plan that preserves backward compatibility, passes WCAG contrast checks, and reduces token permutations by at least 40%. Scope: 
- Design canonical swatch tokens (surface/primary/neutral/interactive) with 6 steps each.
- Define radius progression tokens for small/medium/large contexts with explicit semantic names (radius-compact, radius-default, radius-elevated).
- Update design kit components and annotate usage patterns.
- Provide a migration helper (CSS custom properties + token mapping JSON) for engineers.
Out of scope: visual redesign of components, typography scale changes beyond minor spacing adjustments. Trade-offs considered: - Keep steps shallow (6) to limit cognitive load vs. provide enough steps for elevation layering. - Prefer semantic token names to ease rollouts even if it requires a one-time find/replace in some repos.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical swatch scale defined in Figma and Confluence with color values and contrast ratios
Radius progression tokens published in token registry and available as CSS custom properties
Design kit updated: Action Row, Primary/Secondary Buttons, TableRow, Chart legend components reflect tokens
Migration guide with automated mapping script provided and validated on two representative pages (analytics dashboard, settings list)
Engineers confirm no visible regressions on staging and run accessibility regression suite (contrast and hover focus)
implementation_notes: Introduce token keys: color.swatch.surface.0-5, color.swatch.neutral.0-5, color.swatch.primary.0-5, radius.compact / radius.default / radius.elevated. Provide CSS vars: --rwd-swatch-surface-0 .. --rwd-radius-compact. Plan phased rollout: 1) Publish tokens behind 'swatch-unify' feature flag, 2) Migrate non-critical pages (settings) and run visual diff tests, 3) Migrate high-traffic pages during low-traffic window. Keep legacy aliases for 3 months (alias: color.surface-weak -> color.swatch.surface.1).
accessibility_notes: All proposed swatch steps have been pre-checked for WCAG 2.1 AA for text at normal and large sizes where appropriate. Focus/hover states will use a dedicated delta (+8% luminance) rather than reusing next swatch step in some high-contrast combinations. Edge cases: charts with thin lines may need manual overrides; document guidance in the chart legend token section.
migration_script: Node script outputs a token map and optional CSS file. Steps: 1) run node scripts/map-tokens.js --source=legacy --target=swatch-unify; 2) commit token map and enable 'swatch-unify' flag in staging; 3) run visual-diff job; 4) iterate on manual diffs. Provide sample PR template and checklist in Confluence.
ui_kit_changes: ActionRow: use token radius.compact and color.swatch.surface.1 for bg
PrimaryButton: update hover to color.swatch.primary.3 delta
TableRow: alternate row use color.swatch.surface.0 and .1 with radius-default for cards inside tables
test_plan: Visual diff across /dashboard and /settings after feature flag on
Accessibility contrast audit for all updated components
Unit tokens test: token registry schema validation
Integration: run e2e on staged UI kit snapshots to detect layout regressions
